# IAWARD - Episode 01 of 18: narration script (English)

ACCIONA · CAI · Construction · 45 s · 9:16

Total: **100 spoken words** (target 100-110). Pace: about 2.3 words per second with natural pauses.

## Voice direction
- Clear, confident, warm English voice. Conversational, no hype.
- Say the name as "eye-award" (one word). Do not spell out or expand it.
- "ERP" is read as letters: "E-R-P".
- Slight emphasis on "explicitly approves", and a beat between "AI proposes." and "Buyers approve."
- 0:43-0:45 closing: no narration, music resolves.

## Script by chapter

| Time | Chapter | Narration | Words |
|---|---|---|---|
| 00-04 s | Opening | Meet IAWARD: AI agents for procurement at ACCIONA. | 8 |
| 04-11 s | The project | It supports the whole procurement journey, from purchase request to contract award, and information transfer to the corporate ERP. | 19 |
| 11-17 s | The need | Procurement involves manual tasks, supplier questions and repeated comparisons. IAWARD helps streamline that work. | 14 |
| 17-30 s | How it works | Specialised AI agents prepare requests, compare offers and support negotiation. The buyer supervises throughout, and explicitly approves every supplier selection, negotiation and award decision. AI proposes. Buyers approve. | 28 |
| 30-37 s | Value | The result: the workflow connects operational tasks, while audit records keep proposals and decisions traceable. | 15 |
| 37-43 s | What’s next | Next, planned phases: refinement using historical purchasing data, and adaptation to more countries and local regulations. | 16 |
| 43-45 s | Closing | _(no narration - hold final message)_ | 0 |

## Sound design (for the editor, if audio is added)
- Music: subtle, minimal electronic pulse around 100 BPM, kept at least 15 dB under the voice.
- Restrained SFX only: soft whoosh on each red chapter wipe; paper slide when the request moves;
  a soft click when the buyer presses Approve and a low "stamp" when approval lands. No SFX for AI proposals.
- No audio is embedded in the delivered MP4 (see README).
